name: [Part 1] Unsorted overlapping bookings
test:
def check_plan(bookings, gap):
    before = list(bookings)
    plan = assign_courts(bookings, gap)
    assert bookings == before, 'Do not reorder the caller input'
    assert isinstance(plan, list) and len(plan) == len(bookings)
    assert all(type(c) is int and c >= 0 for c in plan)
    used = set(plan)
    assert used == set(range(len(used))), 'Use consecutive IDs from zero'
    for court in used:
        slots = sorted(b for b, c in zip(bookings, plan) if c == court)
        assert all(a[1] + gap <= b[0] for a, b in zip(slots, slots[1:])), 'Court conflict'
    # Sweep the extended occupancy intervals; releases precede starts on ties.
    events = [(a, 1) for a, b in bookings] + [(b + gap, -1) for a, b in bookings]
    active = peak = 0
    for _, delta in sorted(events):
        active += delta
        peak = max(peak, active)
    assert len(used) == peak, 'A valid plan must also use the minimum courts'

check_plan([(10, 12), (0, 10), (5, 7)], 0)
